description: Timed send-off tips Grady bellows after a new clone accepts the First Hour quest. Flag-gated to play once.

l1.text: Grady bellows after you: "LOOK before you leap, sprat! Type LOOK, read the tile, THEN pick a direction."

l2.text: Grady cups his hands: "That bat does nothing in your bag — EQUIP it! When something ugly turns up, ATTACK it. Simple as breathing."

l3.text: Grady, distant now: "Green line on your map is the GPS — hit AUTO and let your feet follow it east. Go on! Two credits won’t earn themselves!"

name: Grady's Crash Course
